0022600017.text: The Detroit Pistons, 4-1 and first in the Central and the East on a one-game win streak, visit the 0-4 Brooklyn Nets, who have lost four straight, sit 15th in the East, and are fifth in the Atlantic, 3.5 games back, in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A matchup. Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), both listed as out, while Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), both out, and Noah Clowney is day-to-day with an illness and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Pistons won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 138-100 win in Brooklyn on March 10, 2026.
